scope: Fixed before any new full-quality draws. Compare the unchanged block closure with full-second-moment-preserving one-click projection. Pilot0x88002001 records are excluded. Reused PNR records are not new observations.
failure_policy: Any incomplete spectrum makes the complete record an explicit target-zero failure outcome. Keep all rows; no deletion or refill. gates: Small complete-law and independent inverse-moment probes passed. Before full quality, matched full-model numeric/guarded trajectories and thread/chunk invariance must pass for B16/B64.
limits: This47-event99 family is separate from the24-event small-PNR99 family; their automatic combined guarantee is at least98 percent. No precision ratios across those families will be called joint99. Local bounds do not cover the full1152-bit law.
